description: Profile a CSV/TSV dataset: delimiter detection, row and column counts, per-column inferred type (integer, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, string), null/empty counts, distinct values, min/max/mean/median/std and percentiles for numbers, length stats and detected patterns (email, URL, phone) for text, top values, duplicate rows and data-quality warnings. Up to 50,000 rows. POST JSON body {csv}. Returns JSON with: rows, columns, delimiter, duplicateRows, raggedRows, profile, warnings. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/csv-profile
